svg.title: Andrés Zapata, highway
svg.desc: Highway guide signs. Andrés Zapata, software architect, 10+ years, Java and Node.js full stack, 700,000+ users across Colombia and Latam. Overhead signs point to architecture (cloud, DDD, event-driven), integration (EIP, Camel, Kafka) and AI-native work (agents, MCP, skills). Roadside signs: latency limit 100 ms, down from 5 s at 10,000 requests per second for Banco de la República; -40% time-to-market with a developer experience platform; IP/REV nationwide electronic toll interoperability for the Ministry of Transport, plus RUNT services.
